fusions.name: Flail Head
fusions.desc: Whirls the spade-head out on its tether for 13 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Picket Pin
fusions.desc: Throws a tethering stake that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dragline
fusions.desc: Drags a chained scoop along a 6-tile line ahead of you for 5 seconds, hauling nearby enemies toward it and slowing those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Work-Song Cadence
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
